content: {"summary":"CPX‑W430 seen from only one proxy can mean a temporary rolling restart (brief budget halving) or a longer‑lasting missing instance. A rolling restart shows a short‑lived CPX‑W430 while the Deployment rolls one pod at a time; a missing instance shows CPX‑W430 only from the survivor and the other pod stays Pending.","likely_cause":"The evidence distinguishes a rolling restart (temporary) from a missing instance (persistent) based on deployment rollout behavior and pod status.","confidence":"medium","claims":[{"text":"During a rolling restart only one proxy is up, halving the egress budget and causing CPX‑W430 for a minute or two","evidence_ids":["RB-023#3"],"quote":"one proxy carries everything and the egress budget is halved (180 instead of 360 per second)"},{"text":"If CPX‑W430 appears only from one proxy, it indicates the other instance is gone and the survivor handles the full 180 RPS budget","evidence_ids":["RB-029#4"],"quote":"One instance gone; the survivor's 180 is the whole budget"},{"text":"A missing instance will be shown as a Pending pod with scheduling events about anti‑affinity or taints","evidence_ids":["RB-029#4"],"quote":"The missing one is `Pending`, with a scheduling event naming anti-affinity or taints"},{"text":"A rolling restart can be verified by checking the rollout status command output","evidence_ids":["RB-023#3"],"quote":"k rollout restart deploy/card-processor-proxy && k rollout status deploy/card-processor-proxy"}],"next_checks":["Run `kubectl rollout status deploy/card-processor-proxy` for the 2026‑07‑15 window to see if a rollout was in progress","List pods with `kubectl get pods -l app=card-processor-proxy -o wide` for 2026‑09‑16 and note any pod in Pending state","Inspect logs around 2026‑07‑15 and 2026‑09‑16 for CPX‑W430 timestamps and duration","Check node‑selector and anti‑affinity events in the pod description to confirm a scheduling issue"]}
